svg.title: Dynamic Regime GNN final project poster
svg.desc: Large technical poster aligned with the report, summarizing a dynamic heterogeneous graph neural network for market regime detection across 30-stock and 500-stock experimental settings.

g.text: Dynamic Regime GNN for Market Regime Detection
Dynamic heterogeneous graph learning over daily stock-market snapshots.
Dual task: regime classification + stress early warning over t+5..t+20
Financial stress is relational: stocks co-move through sector exposure,
ownership, and supply-chain links. The model reads a sequence of daily
heterogeneous graphs rather than isolated stock time series.
20-day SPY return, 20-day realized volatility, and average cross-sectional correlation.
correlation edges, co-ownership edges, and supplier/customer edges.
Yahoo Finance data, SPY and VIX market context, train 2018-2021 and validation 2022-2024.
Validation labels include 109 Stress days and 142 transition-positive examples.
sparse graph: corr_top_k=5, corr_bot_k=3; dense comparison: 10/5
Best checkpoint: epoch 2, sparse correlation graph.
Prediction counts on Setting A validation set.
Crash is absent from predictions; Stress is under-predicted but partly recovered.
Workbook-driven graph with direct holder and supplier/customer metadata.
This setting tests graph scale and direct relationship metadata, not final benchmark performance.
Epoch 9 gives the best macro-F1; epoch 10 is the final checkpoint.
Next steps: held-out test set, multiple seeds, non-graph baselines, PR-AUC, threshold calibration, and longer 500-stock training.
Reproducibility: uv sync --dev; uv run pytest -q; uv build; artifacts saved as JSON.
